extensions.name: Face recognition

release.notes: Offline YuNet detector (MIT, Copyright 2020 Shiqi Yu) and SFace embedder (Apache-2.0), plus ONNX Runtime 1.28 (MIT, Microsoft) for Linux x86_64. Photos stay on this computer. macOS and Windows packages are not published.

extensions.summary: Optional Gallery add-on. Detects faces and groups them on this computer. Photos are not uploaded. Updates stay manual until you choose automatic.
